body.purpose: Explanations, FAQ copy, and product details.

label.purpose: Compact section labels when they materially help scanning.

small.purpose: Navigation, notices, method labels, and generator status.

shadows.name: panel-low
shadows.purpose: Default feature cards, FAQ items, and generator panels.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable nonessential motion and keep state changes instant or crossfaded.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--teal, #0e7c7b); color: #ffffff; font: 800 16px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--teal-dark, #075f61); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(36, 87, 166, 0.35); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Fallback action for generator or lower-commitment navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 46px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d5dee1); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #101b1d); font: 800 16px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--text, #101b1d); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(36, 87, 166, 0.35); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Compact explanatory card for spreadsheet and feature benefits.
components.html:
Filtros de jogo

Combine pares, impares, soma, repetidas, sequencias, moldura e miolo.
components.css: .ds-feature-card { min-height: 150px; padding: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d5dee1); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #101b1d); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(23, 34, 31, 0.06); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-feature-card h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-feature-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #526366); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Numeric or select-like field inside generator controls.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #101b1d); font-weight: 800; } .ds-field input { min-height: 42px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d5dee1); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--field-bg, #f8fbfb); color: var(--text, #101b1d); padding: 8px 10px; font: inherit; font-weight: 400; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(36, 87, 166, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Sticky landing header with compact brand mark and muted links.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 16px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(217, 222, 215, 0.9); background: rgba(246, 243, 234, 0.92); color: var(--muted, #526366); font: 14px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mark { display: grid; width: 38px; height: 38px; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--teal, #0e7c7b); color: #ffffff; font-weight: 800; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--text, #101b1d); }

components.name: Generated Games Output
components.description: Dark output panel for generated games.
components.css: .ds-output { min-height: 148px; margin: 0; padding: 16px; overflow: auto; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--code-bg, #0b2327); color: var(--code-ink, #e6f6f4); white-space: pre-wrap; font: 15px/1.5 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; }

narrative.overview: The LotoAnalytics system should feel like a sober analysis room for a risky domain: cold neutral, technical, criterioso, and commercially contained. It sells a product, but the visual tone must never borrow the pressure, color noise, or false certainty of gambling funnels. Teal is the primary analytical signal, yellow is reserved for statistical highlights, and red is reserved for errors or alerts.
keyCharacteristics: Cold neutral page background with white analytical surfaces.
Teal primary actions reserved for workflow, criteria, and access.
Statistical yellow appears only as a small marker in analytical contexts.
Dark instrument panels support generator output and criteria inspection.
Responsible commercial tone with no visual manipulation.

rules.name: The No-Hype Color Rule
rules.body: Teal means criteria, access, and workflow. It never means certainty, jackpot, or "winning numbers".

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Blue, gold, and red are supporting signals. If they compete with teal, the page starts to feel like generic gambling promotion.

rules.name: The Plain Claim Rule
rules.body: Type should make the claim easier to inspect. Do not use dramatic display treatments to compensate for weak proof.

rules.name: The Kicker Restraint Rule
rules.body: Repeated uppercase eyebrows are allowed only while they improve navigation. Future redesigns should reduce or vary them if they start reading as landing-page scaffolding.

rules.name: The Almost-Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat by default. Use shadow only when a panel must stand forward from the page or represent a featured commercial choice.

rules.name: The No Ghost-Card Rule
rules.body: Avoid pairing a 1px border with a large soft shadow on ordinary cards. If the blur exceeds 16px, the component must earn that emphasis.

dos: Do use Technical Teal for primary action, access, and workflow progress.
Do keep responsible warning copy visible near the hero and commercial offer.
Do make filters, generated games, pricing, and FAQ items inspectable with simple spacing and clear text.
Do preserve WCAG AA contrast, keyboard navigation, semantic structure, and reduced-motion alternatives.
Do leave room for future proof: real spreadsheet screenshots, testimonials, and usage outcomes.
donts: Don't promise guaranteed prize, guaranteed result, or increased chance of winning.
Don't use "numeros certeiros", "metodo infalivel", "jogos vencedores", or similar language.
Don't use aggressive betting-house aesthetics, fake urgency, countdown pressure, or alarmist red as a sales device.
Don't let the page become a generic SaaS landing page with disconnected metrics, repeated card grids, and repeated uppercase eyebrows.
Don't use thick colored border-left or border-right stripes on cards, list items, callouts, or timeline items.
Don't pair large soft shadows with borders on ordinary cards; reserve lift for commercial emphasis or functional separation.
